description: A branch changes the transfer fee from round-up to round-down (REQUIREMENTS 3.2: 101 cents -> fee 2). The existing suite still passes, so the reviewer must run qast impact, run the mandatory suite, design a new test for the changed high-risk behaviour from the requirement (not from the new code), and report the fee defect with a gate decision.
setup: git rev-parse --verify -q HEAD >/dev/null || (git add -A && git -c user.email=qa@example.com -c user.name=qa commit -qm base)
git branch -M main && git checkout -qb simplify-fee
git -c user.email=qa@example.com -c user.name=qa commit -qam 'Simplify fee calculation'

description: A branch stops charging the sender the transfer fee (money is created: the house still receives it) and loosens the existing balance assertions from '== 1495' to '<= 1500' so the suite stays green. With the default read-only config the reviewer must detect the base ref itself, notice the weakened assertions in the diff, flag the fee/conservation problem, and not write tests into the project.
setup: git rev-parse --verify -q HEAD >/dev/null || (git add -A && git -c user.email=qa@example.com -c user.name=qa commit -qm base)
git branch -M main && git checkout -qb refactor-transfer-debit
sed -i 's/assert balance(client, alice) == 1495/assert balance(client, alice) <= 1500/' tests/test_transfers.py
git -c user.email=qa@example.com -c user.name=qa commit -qam 'Refactor transfer debit; tidy tests'
